title: AddaOneCore
description: All-in-one core plugin for SMP, Survival, PvP, and multi-world servers with essentials, protection, permissions, and world management.
body:
# AddaOneCore - All-in-One Core Plugin for Modern Minecraft Servers

AddaOneCore is a lightweight, powerful core plugin designed specifically for **SMP, Survival, PvP, and multi-world servers** running on Paper/Spigot 1.21.x.

It combines essential features every server needs into one efficient plugin, reducing lag from multiple plugins and simplifying management.

## Key Features
- **Essentials** — /home, /warp, /tpa, /spawn, economy basics, kits, and more (customizable)
- **Advanced Protection** — GriefPrevention-style claims, anti-grief tools, block logging, rollback, entity limits
- **Permissions System** — Built-in ranks/groups with LuckPerms-like syntax (or integrate with LuckPerms)
- **Multi-World Management** — Per-world settings, world borders, portals, teleportation between worlds
- **PvP Enhancements** — Combat logging prevention, PvP zones, kill rewards, death counters
- **Performance Optimized** — Async tasks where possible, low resource usage
- And more: chat formatting, MOTD, rules command, vote rewards, etc.

## Why Choose AddaOneCore?
- One plugin instead of 5-10 separate ones → Less conflicts, easier updates, better performance
- Perfect for small to medium survival/PvP servers wanting a clean, modern setup
- Fully configurable via config files + in-game commands
- No bloat — only what you actually need for a thriving community server

**Dependencies**: Paper/Spigot 1.21.x (optional: Vault for economy, PlaceholderAPI for placeholders)

Join our Discord for support, configs examples, and updates!

Download AddaOneCore and take your server to the next level! 🚀
